value: The investor relations desk is open Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00, and is closed on public holidays.
Capital call wires must arrive by 15:00 on the due date to count as on time.
Overdue capital call amounts accrue simple interest at 9 percent a year, counted daily from the due date.
Quarterly statements are posted to the portal 45 days after quarter end; audited annual accounts follow 120 days after year end.
HCP-01 charges 1.75 percent a year on commitments during the investment period, 20 percent carry over an 8 percent hurdle.
HCP-02 charges 1.25 percent a year on invested capital, 15 percent carry over a 6 percent hurdle.
HCP-03 charges 1.0 percent a year on invested capital, 12.5 percent carry over a 7 percent hurdle.
HCP-04 charges 1.5 percent a year on net invested capital, 20 percent carry over an 8 percent hurdle.
HCP-01 is still investing; it has called 78 percent of commitments to date.
HCP-02 is harvesting and is paying distributions from asset sales; it has called 96.5 percent of commitments.
HCP-03 is in its investment period; it has called 41.5 percent of commitments.
HCP-04 is harvesting and is in its final years; it has called 99.2 percent of commitments.
HCP-02 states its NAV and distributions in euro; the other three funds use US dollars.
Any transfer of a limited partner interest needs the general partner's written consent and 30 days notice.
An administrative fee of 2,500 USD applies to each approved transfer of interest.
Capital call and distribution notices are posted to the investor portal at 9:00 on the notice date.
Capital calls give investors 14 days between the notice date and the due date.
The desk and this assistant do not give investment, tax or legal advice; investors go to their own advisers.
Changes to bank details need a signed form uploaded in the investor portal; chat cannot change them.
Q3 2026 statements are due on the portal by 2026-11-14.
